ANUTOSH TRIVEDI Data Science & Analytics

Email: trivedianutosh26@gmail.com Mobile: +91-9145728977 LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/anutosh- trivedi-81379779/

Senior AI & Data Science professional with 7+ years of experience delivering advanced analytics, ML/DL models, and Gen AI solutions. Specialized in predictive modeling, decision intelligence, and LLM-based systems that convert large-scale data into actionable insights, driving automation, efficiency, and measurable business outcomes.

PROFILE SUMMARY

AI Engineer with proven success in delivering data-driven solutions across industries, currently leading strategic analytics







initiatives at Mercedes-Benz R&D. Expert in advanced analytics, statistical modeling, and machine learning to optimize business performance, improve forecast accuracy, and solve real-world problems. Skilled in deriving insights from complex datasets through exploratory analysis, feature engineering, and model interpretation, with hands-on deployment of end-to-end solutions. Strong communicator with a talent for translating technical outputs into clear business narratives, enabling actionable decisions across cross-functional and non-technical teams.

SOFT SKILLS

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Critical Thinking

Problem-Solving

Adaptability

Ownership







Programming Languages & Frameworks: Python, PySpark, Flask, FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph Python Libraries: Pandas, Numpy, scikit-learn, seaborn, matplotlib, geopandas, pytorch, tensorflow, keras, NLTK, Spacy, H3, onnx, BeautifulSoup, pypdf, folium Cloud Technologies: AWS-S3, Azure Databricks, ADLS, Azure OpenAI, Azure Monitoring, Azure KeyVault, Azure ML Endpoint

Accountability

Communication

Data Warehousing & Databases: Snowflake, MongoDB, SQL • Project Management & Collaboration Tools: MS Excel, Jira, Confluence, Git, AirFlow, Azure DevOps, Jenkins

AI/ML Models & Algorithms: Linear and Logistic Regression,

Random Forest, Decision Tree, PCA, NLP, Clustering Algorithms (DBSCAN, K-means, K-medoids), Ensemble Techniques (Bagging and Boosting), LightGBM, XGBoost, GenAI, Milvus, GPT-4, LLM, SHAP, LIME, OpenAI, Optuna.

WORK EXPERIENCE

Oct’23-Present: Senior Engineer at Mercedes Benz Research and Development India (MBRDI), Bengaluru Key Result Areas:

2020-2021

Designed and deployed a RAG-powered Generative AI pipeline for generating insights and suggestions for internal business teams, enabling intelligent recommendations and automated insight generation from millions of Spark- enriched data records.

Directed a cross-functional initiative with marketing and sales teams to launch a strategic campaign focused on EU cities, utilizing proprietary clustering algorithms and building KPIs to identify and quantify the risk potential of hotspots.

Presented the insights and results to stakeholders and business leaders to foster pro-active actions on improving road

safety standards and monetize the product.

• Designed SAFeR model to quantify the complexity of hotspots based on the accident data and vehicle data and aligned product capabilities with stakeholder needs - including civic bodies - ensuring continuous model improvement and real- world business impact.

Highlights: DaaS (Data as a Service) • Developed a scalable data enrichment product used in 25+ countries, leveraging Spark, machine learning, and clustering algorithms to enable the data collection team to significantly improve test drive coverage and efficiency.

Enabled new analytics capabilities by creating KPIs to quantify road infrastructure complexity near junctions and

roundabouts to mitigate the risk at cross traffic and pedestrian crossing.

Road Safety Hotspot Campaigns •

Identified and Classified high risk potential hotspots from integrated data sources using classical ML models and algorithms like DBSCAN and XGBoostClassifier to scale the product to other countries across the EMEA region.

Built and deployed robust ML-powered pipeline in Spark using MLFlow, enabling monthly updates on the high risk

hotspots and tracking key metrics for continuous monitoring.

Designed and implemented a multi-lingual GenAI-powered RAG pipeline using GPT-4, OpenAI, LLM, LangChain, and vector DBs to auto-generate human-readable observations and intelligent suggestions for the high-risk potential hotspots from Spark-enriched data, enabling non-technical stakeholders and customers to access actionable insights instantly and reduce manual reporting effort by 70%.

Apr’22-Sep’23: Data Scientist at Anko (Kmart Australia), Bengaluru Highlights: Customer Lapse Analysis | CLTV Model Implementation • Created and implemented a Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) model using probabilistic models, predictive analytics, and

customer segmentation; this initiative led to a 13% recovery rate of churned customers within the first month, generating an additional AUD 200K in profit and guiding retention strategies.

Product Quality Governance Tools | Cost Reduction • Developed and deployed Product Quality Governance Tools using streamlit and Flask APIs to automate factory

inspection processes; this innovation reduced man-hour costs, facilitated data-driven product quality audits, and minimized manual involvement and inspection errors.

Shrink Analysis | Supplier Performance Automation • Automated a Shrink Analysis mechanism which enabled data-driven supplier return thresholds; this boosted claim

amounts by 40%, improved product quality and streamlined the supply chain by removing manual negotiations between buyers and suppliers.

PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE

Mar’21-Apr’22: Data Scientist at Gramener Technology Solutions, Bengaluru

Aug’20-Feb’21: Associate Big Data Engineer at Celebal Technologies, Jaipur

Aug’17-May’19: Associate Engineer at Sears Holdings India, Pune

EDUCATION

PG Diploma in Data Science Engineering from Great Lakes Institute of Management in 2020 • B.Tech./B.E. in Electronics & Comm. Engineering from University College of Engineering Rajasthan Technical University in 2016

PERSONAL DETAILS

Date of Birth: 26th March 1993 Languages Known: Hindi, English Permanent Address: - Udaipur, Rajasthan Current Address: - Bengaluru, Karnataka
